records.notes: Official HKJC racecard routes provide Race 1-N post times and programme-summary fields. The operational source identity is bound to explicit reviewed import because hosted direct HTTP acquisition is not evidence-backed. Existing reviewed Happy Valley evidence contains nine continuous races and A+ technical fields; public output remains capped at A. Participant, betting, result, payout, prediction, raw-source, embedded-video, and direct-stream data remain excluded.
